t: 四岁的亨利四世在亚琛被加冕为德国国王.
te: Four year-old Henry IV is crowned as king of Germany in Aachen.
dz: 四岁的亨利四世在亚琛被加冕为德国国王.
de: Four year-old Henry IV is crowned as king of Germany in Aachen.

t: 达马苏斯二世当选教皇,23天后去世.
te: Damasus II is elected pope, and dies 23 days later.
